title: k-Fold Cross-Validation by Hand
learning_objectives: Use CV to choose a hyperparameter
entry_point: kfold_indices(n, k, seed=None); cross_val_score(fit, score, X, y, k=5, seed=0)
hints: `order = np.arange(n)` or the seeded permutation; `folds = np.array_split(order, k)`.
Train indices for fold i: `np.concatenate([f for j, f in enumerate(folds) if j != i])`.
Loop over folds calling fit and score, collecting scores into an array.

failure_feedback.advice: Use np.array_split so the first n % k folds are one larger.
Each index must appear in exactly one test fold; train = all other folds.
Shuffle with default_rng(seed).permutation(n) only when seed is not None.
Call fit on the training fold and score on the test fold.
